environment.network: offline fixtures only; no paid provider requests

scope.cli: Existing offline build through scripts/superpi.mjs, isolated empty HOME/cwd, bundled resources and tools disabled, diagnostic preload. 1 warmup + 5 measured child processes per mode. Not full configured-user startup.
scope.cold: Fresh process/module graph, not OS disk-cache cold boot. Model runtime benchmark includes child process startup.
scope.markdown: Production Markdown component, identity theme/no syntax highlighter, synthetic growing plain/code/table content; 10 warmup + 30 timed updates; not terminal end-to-end latency.
scope.resize: Production RetainedContainer with real UserMessageComponent/AssistantMessageComponent and existing mixed fixture. Six timed alternating 120/96-width changes after two warmups, no terminal write.
scope.allocation: Sampling estimates, not exact allocation counts. Post-disposal reference counters are bounded; a single positive heap delta alone is not evidence of a leak.

cli.scope: Isolated empty workspace; no tools/bundled resources/network; diagnostic preload; not native PTY or sandbox shutdown

prefix.interpretation: Each timing sample contains 100 resource-order permutations/builds. Divide sample time by 100 for an average build cost; this is not a per-request latency percentile or a cloud cache-hit ratio.

cacheScan.scope: detectCacheMiss only, synthetic all-assistant history with misses; excludes getEntries array copy; feature disabled by default.

validation.temporaryFixtureCorrection: Initial plain fixture ended in a space and appended another space, intentionally unsafe after correction diagnosis. Final plain numbers use trimEnd; original double-space result is not used as normal plain-text latency.
validation.harnessInvocationError: One mistyped exploratory runner argument node-does-not-exist exited 1 before loading product code; excluded from all benchmark results.

findings.evidence: Width change measures every viewport record synchronously; 50k real components are roughly 10x 5k.
findings.next: Design viewport-first resize with bounded background measurement and stable scroll anchors; preserve exact selection/history behavior. Profile before choosing a data structure.

findings.area: startup module graph and timing coverage
findings.evidence: Static mode/package/export imports precede main timing and version exit. Cold model runtime much slower than warm construction; uninstrumented --version also loads the CLI graph.
findings.next: Move version/help and mode dispatch behind minimal entry; profile imports separately. Existing provider API lazy imports already exist and should be preserved.

findings.evidence: Plain append is incremental; long code/table fixtures reparse and rewrap each update.
findings.next: Profile append-tail block handling/table layout; cache only semantically stable work with bounded owner and invalidation. Preserve fence/link/table-width behavior.

findings.evidence: Per-turn detectCacheMiss scans history and creates a map it discards; UI uses global five-minute idle threshold despite API adapters supporting different retention modes.
findings.next: Connect actual usage to effective manifest drift and provider/retention metadata; distinguish heuristic attribution from observed facts. Track incremental state by branch/history generation.

findings.evidence: Intent and effective manifests both normalize/hash stable context/tool schemas; intent recomputes canonical context hash within a build. 100 ordering permutations produced zero drift at both tested sizes.
findings.next: Memoize stable component hashes under explicit resource/tool/schema generations; preserve provider effective-dispatch hashing and transform invalidation.

findings.evidence: Idle pipe-backed quit is already tens of milliseconds; terminal drain uses adaptive quiet-window, not an unconditional 1000ms sleep.
findings.next: Measure active stream/tool/sandbox and slow extension cleanup separately before changing deadlines or hook semantics.

reproduction.instructions: Create a fresh task-owned .task-tmp/<id>/ directory at repository depth 2; restore harnesses below there; run recorded argument lists through run.mjs with that task path. All TMP/TEMP/TMPDIR and HOME are isolated. Run timing benchmarks sequentially. Existing production benchmark scripts are pinned by commit.
